answer: Every identity keeps a marble, a non-transferable pass bought with nectar, and must renew it each epoch through the velvet gate or drop off the registry. Renewal is priced per owner: holding n identities costs n squared nectar per marble, so one identity costs 1 nectar per epoch while 1,000 puppets cost 1,000,000 nectar each, 1 billion per epoch in total. No bulk discount applies, since the price follows how many marbles one owner holds, and splitting puppets across wallets fails, because funding traced on-chain counts them as one owner. An honest newcomer pays 1 nectar per epoch.
